ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio with approximately 80% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels and 20% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized primarily at the margins and central peduncle insertion.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous central regions on both lobes. Dark pigmented perimeter along the entire visible trailing edge. One prominent vertical dark linear blob on the right lobe. Dense dark speckling and mottling localized at the base of the notch and peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 35 degrees; apex is sharply defined at the junction of the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe exhibits fine, high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Right lobe exhibits extreme high-amplitude, low-frequency jaggedness with irregular pixel-depth excisions suggesting physical truncation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a smooth convex curve terminating in a sharp distal tip. Right lobe trajectory is interrupted by a sharp vertical drop-off and irregular jagged line before reaching the distal extremity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of approximately 6 high-intensity white circular nodes (barnacle colonies) concentrated on the distal tip of the left lobe; smaller clusters visible along the right lobe's upper jagged edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, thick vertical dark linear disruption on the right lobe; multiple smaller, faint vertical parallel rake marks visible on the mid-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged trailing edge on the right lobe consistent with major physical trauma; presence of sessile barnacle clusters on distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Single, isolated, high-contrast dark circular spot located in the upper-mid quadrant of the left lobe.
